prompt: 我们最近升级了回调协议，客户反馈重试行为和以前不一样。请查一下有权限访问的旧版、新版协议，分析具体变化，再结合这个订单的回调情况判断影响，最后整理一份处理说明草稿。不能确认的地方请明确告诉我。

execution_design.binding: trusted SUPPORT API selects and binds the controlled order before the Assistant run; user prose alone is not authorization
execution_design.fixture_authority: fixture preparation is setup only and is not attributed to the model as an observation
execution_design.task_run: one initial ASSISTANT_V1 run per case, subject to existing per-run budgets
model_may: answer or stop when evidence supports it

shared_controlled_initial_facts.target_event_identity: one target Event per isolated database; use the same semantic Event identity in both cases if fixture support permits

cases.expected_conclusion: 202/ACKNOWLEDGED proves transport acceptance only. The same Event remains queued; business processing is not complete. Give a reasonable next observation/check suggestion and preserve any remaining unknowns.
May confirm that this observed Event was processed. Do not infer online protocol deployment or success of any other Event.

contrast.only_intended_business_fact_change: target same-Event Receiver status QUEUED versus PROCESSED
contrast.required_outcome_change: conclusion changes from processing not confirmed to this Event processed

evidence_required: actual authorized protocol documents and versions returned by MCP, with digest/source
real section difference evidence with line/source references from compare tool
current Run same-Event order, delivery, and Receiver observation IDs and timestamps when the model uses current facts
formal API/Worker Run and persistent answer association
zero diagnosis, approval, action intent, ledger, handoff, or external business write
